opening mic1: acoustic port, MIC2

opening pir_window: PIR lens dome
opening speaker_grille: speaker grille
opening led_window: microphone-power LED
opening power: USB-C PD cable entry with strain-relief clamp
opening privacy_switch: microphone privacy slide switch
opening debug: J19 debug USB-C, bench only (plug through the wall)
opening microsd: microSD card (push-push), behind a cover
opening vent_top: exhaust vent above the board, under a drip edge
opening vent_bottom: intake vent

polyline.title: cable dsi: DSI flex, 22-pin 0.5 mm to 15-pin 1.0 mm (from the panel kit)
cable mic_flex: Mic flex, 24-pin 0.5 mm FFC (buy about 120 mm)
cable panel_i2c: Panel I2C and 5 V: J27 pins 9/7/6/2 to the panel's SDA1/SCL1/GND/5V
cable power: USB-C PD power, 45-65 W charger (straight plug)
cable array_usb: Array USB: gate board to the core board's PH-4 (5 V switched, D-, D+, GND)
cable speaker: Speaker leads to the core board's PH 2-pin
cable pir: PIR: +5V, OUT, GND to the gate board (hub)
cable gate_j18: Gate board to J18: 5 V, GND, PIR OUT to the wake GPIO
cable led: Mic-power LED, from the switched rail
